_comment: Tweakable working-sets playground for dz dazzle-update.
Underscore keys are comments and never warn. Each set below
demonstrates one mechanism of the rule language -- edit freely
and re-run; membership follows the file, even under --cached.
Rule of thumb from the measurements: globs belong in
vetoes everything, 'declared: true' adds repos that kit
_comment_cache: Private cache so playground replays never mix with the shared user cache (or anything a test agent writes there). Seed it once with a fresh run, then --cached replays are instant.

dazzle._comment: The measured set: org body + 2 exact includes + declaration. This exact shape scored 1.00 precision / 1.00 recall against the adjudicated ground truth.

wtf._comment: A product line as a repo-glob body. Overlaps dazzle on wtf-windows (declaration on one side, glob on the other) -- overlap is a lens, not a conflict.

comfy._comment: TRANSFERABILITY TEST -- an org body plus a cross-org text glob. Judge the membership against your mental model; if the language fights you here, that is the finding.

claude._comment: A purely cross-org text set: claude tooling lives in DazzleML, djdarcy, and dazzle-claude-* names. Tweak idea: exclude the dated dazzle-claude-vault and see the roster change.

repokit._comment: A sub-org slice: namespaces globs work at repo granularity too.
